page.overview:
Who is Ally of Justice Garadholg?

Ally of Justice Garadholg, rendered Ally of Justice - Garadholg in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator, is a character version of the card, "Ally of Justice Garadholg".

It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator.
